evidence.decision: Separates decorative/informative/editable/action imagery, then chooses fit versus crop from preserved meaning and button semantics for activation.
evidence.artifact: Requires changed asset/container behavior and a semantic contract; review repairs must identify the actual crop, role or legibility defect.
evidence.transformation: Museum map example replaces stretched map and unexplained image gesture with complete fitted content and a named View Route button.
evidence.verification: Checks aspect changes, bright/dark overlay readability and keyboard/assistive activation, failing lost essential content or unnamed action images.
evidence.applicability: Carries Mac image-well editing, tvOS layered transparency and visionOS presentation mechanisms without claiming untested framework support.
evidence.handoffs: Routes editing to image-wells, actions to buttons and asset strategy to images according to the diagnosed task.
evidence.distinctiveness: Image fitting and animation preparation are tied to content meaning and control semantics; this cannot substitute for a text or generic container procedure.
